
# Books App

A web application for browsing and managing books.

## Pages

- [Books home](http://localhost:5173/books)
- [Book details](http://localhost:5173/books/1)
- [Create a new book](http://localhost:5173/new)

## Main features

- Browse books
- View individual book details
- Create a new book

## Technical information

- Frontend: React
- Development server: Vite
